{{Quote|Captain! Nossor Ri and the Quarren are with you.|The soldier talking to captain Ackbar|<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this '''[[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]''' lived on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-wide [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and participated in the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]], where he fought the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] in their [[Coral City/Legends|capital city]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces and the Mon Calamari lost the second attack and most residents of the capital city and the Republic aides were taken captive. Among them, Mon Calamari prince [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]] was also taken captive and was sentenced to public execution by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]].

Before the execution began, many of the prisoners, including [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], and the Quarren, were brought to witness the prince's death. The Quarren chieftain, [[Nossor Ri/Legends|Nossor Ri]], who was convinced earlier by the prince to rebel against the Separatists, decided to help the Republic and the Mon Calamari and sent his soldiers to provide them with weapons. This soldier gave his [[spear blaster]] to Ackbar, and before the execution began, the Quarren rebelled against the Separatists and re-joined the Mon Calamari and the Republic.
